title: Waacking Tutorial For Beginners | How To Waack - Part 1 | DanceWithAbby

method.teacher_system: Abhilasha introduces the three aspects of waacking, breaks down the single arm roll step-by-step with imagery, and practises it across slow, medium, and fast tempos for both arms.

practices.what: Breaks down the arm roll into four individual picture positions to clarify the pathway.
Increases the drilling speed from slow to medium and fast tempos for the right arm.
Repeats continuous rounds of the drill at challenge speed without stopping.

adaptations.difficulty: One arm feels stronger or less coordinated than the other.
adaptations.adjustment: Train your weaker side more so that both arms look equally graceful.

adaptations.difficulty: Going fast makes it hard to fully extend arms before hitting the shoulder.
adaptations.adjustment: Take a shortcut over your head when going fast, but fully extend when going slow.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes viewers and introduces the waacking tutorial series for beginners.

struggles.theme: Fast tempo is too tough and hard to follow on day one
Fast tempo makes waacking lose its cool posing look
Trouble finding the mentioned app in description

clicked.theme: Well explained and easy to learn step by step

requests.theme: Ask for more waacking tutorials and part 3
Request specific song tutorials and 360 hand rolls

meant.theme: Express deep gratitude and love for the positive teaching vibes

method.limits: The video only covers the single arm roll aspect of waacking and does not show partner work or footwork.
